newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says on track for 97/98 GDP forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says on track for 97/98 GDP forecast.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the economy is on track to achieve economic growth of 3.75 percent in the year to June 30, 1998.

Asked by reporters whether the government would be reviewing its gross domestic product (GDP) forecast after Wednesday's June quarter inflation data, Costello said: "What we are seeing to date is quite consistent with that (figure)."
"Growth is strengthening and there is a better inflation outlook and a good interest rate outlook. It is a good climate that is developing," Costello said.
He said the government would be reviewing its forecasts at its mid-year review of the budget forecasts.
Figures released earlier on Wednesday showed Australia's consumer price index (CPI) fell 0.2 percent in the June quarter for an annual rate of 0.3 percent.
Underlying inflation rose 0.3 percent in the quarter for a year-on-year rate of 1.7 percent.
